title: Can American Politics Ever Be ‘Normal’ Again, AFTER Trump?
author: John Harwood
content:
As far as Donald Trump has fallen, says former Republican focus group maestro
**Sarah Longwell** of The Bulwark, he needs to fall further before the country
can decisively move forward. Can Democrats make it happen, or even Trump
himself? Longwell joins **Zeteo 's John Harwood **for a live conversation on
Substack to break it all down.
